description: Look up and COUNT US federal disaster declarations (FEMA DisasterDeclarationsSummaries). Filters: state (2-letter), incidentType (e.g. 'Fire', 'Flood', 'Hurricane', 'Severe Storm'), declarationType ('DR' major disaster, 'EM' emergency, 'FM' fire management), year (fyDeclared, the federal FISCAL year), and since/until for a real calendar date range — use since/until for questions like 'in the past year', which a fiscal year does not answer. Counts are DISTINCT DISASTERS by default, not table rows: FEMA publishes one row per disaster per designated county, so Hurricane Harvey is ~60 rows for Texas but one declaration. Pass designatedArea or grain:'area' for county-level rows. Returns the most recent first.

designatedArea.description: Filter to a designated area, e.g. 'Harris (County)'. Implies county-level grain.

grain.description: 'disaster' (default) = one record per declaration; 'area' = one record per designated county.

orderby.description: OData $orderby, default 'declarationDate desc'. Live-API path only.

since.description: Only declarations on/after this date — ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD'. Use with until for windows like 'the past year'.

until.description: Only declarations on/before this date — ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD'.

year.description: Federal FISCAL year declared (fyDeclared), e.g. 2024. For a calendar window use since/until instead.

name: disaster_declarations
title: Disaster Declarations
